verdict.rationale: Docs mention that agents deploy to 'isolated sandboxes monday manages' and that versions can be scaffolded and promoted from chat, implying a dev/test environment separate from production infra, but there is no explicit description of a sandbox for testing against non-production data or verification this isolation covers board/data-level testing. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment for data testing, independent or hands-on confirmation that production data is untouched.
